snippet.title: Loss Prevention - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list? Watch the Loss Prevention trailer to see what you can expect. Loss Prevention will be available on PC via Steam on March 31, 2026.
